text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text:
"WOOOOOOOO!?!?
Seiun Sky took the win!?!?"

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
S-Seriously!?
I was totally sure it was Spe, but...!

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
W-Whoa...
Seiun Sky is amazing!!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Yes, this is it! This is what I've been wanting.
Something I've wanted to taste for so long...!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Ahhh, feels so good...♪

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Geez, what are you spacing out for?!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
...Well, that was the result of going all out against you.
I have no regrets.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Congratulations, Sei-chan!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
"It's frustrating, but today Sei-chan was...
really, truly shining!"

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: You two...

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Hehe, thanks a bunch♪

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Hey, Sei-chan.
Have you decided on your next race?

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: If not, then I want you to run in the Arima Kinen!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: The "Arima Kinen"...

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
I heard Grass-chan is planning to enter too.
I want to run with Sei-chan again too!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Next time, I'll definitely...
surpass Sei-chan...!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Whoa, declaring a rematch already? Man, you really never let me bask in the victory, do you~?

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Surpassing me, huh...

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Then I have no choice but to accept.
I want to cook up an even more incredible strategy, after all♪

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Then...!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Yeah.
Shall we head to the Arima Kinen, then?

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
By the way, King,
are you sure you don't want a rematch~?

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Hmph. I won't fall for that provocation.
I've already decided to enter a different race.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
I will run my own path
and repaint your brilliance today in the King's colors.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Enjoy your short-lived glory while it lasts!
Ohohoho!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Fufu... Oka~y.
I'll be looking forward to it~♪

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Ah... My heart won't stop pounding...

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
(Next time will be even more, so much more...!
An even more thrilling race than today—)

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
...Trainer!
Trai~ner~?

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Ah...! Hey, listen!
I—

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Ah.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Wait, my legs are—

text_block_list.name: Doctor
text_block_list.text: —You're injured, aren't you?

Without warning, Seiun Sky collapsed.
In a panic, I rushed her to the doctor...
only to receive a ruthless diagnosis.

text_block_list.name: Doctor
text_block_list.text:
No, it is not that serious.
It shouldn't interfere with your training.

text_block_list.name: Doctor
text_block_list.text:
She should be fine for a little while, but...
considering her future, I wouldn't recommend running right now.

text_block_list.name: Doctor
text_block_list.text:
Taking a break and treating it slowly.
Thinking of the future, as a doctor, I believe that is the decision you should make.

As Seiun Sky remained silent even after the doctor left,
I told him my decision as his Trainer...
choice_data_list: Let's think of it as a good stopping point.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
...Does that mean you've decided
not to run in this year's Arima Kinen?

She still has a long life as an athlete ahead of her.
To ensure her future is fully protected,
I explained my plan to take our time with recovery.
choice_data_list: There will still be chances to race against rivals

text_block_list.text:
She's smart. She will surely understand.
Or so I thought, but—

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: ...I don't want to.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
"No!
My chance to run—is now or never!!"

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
This year's Arima Kinen is...
guaranteed to be something special.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: I'm the one who's gonna make it interesting! So there's no way I'm not running...!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
I can win. I've finally gotten over the hump!
The fun part starts right now...!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Spe-chan, Grass-chan, and everyone else who grew stronger by pushing past their limits!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: I'm going to... turn everything around and win!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
That's why I have to run in the race.
I absolutely... absolutely want to run...!

It seems I had misjudged her passion.
In that case—

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: ...What do you mean?
choice_data_list: I want to improve training efficiency.

text_block_list.text: I explained that by shortening training time while increasing the density of the routine, the saved time could be redirected toward warm-ups and recovery care.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: ...! That means...

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
I can do it. I move briskly and follow instructions.
I won't slack off, either.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: That's why—
choice_data_list: Let's make sure to finish the Arima Kinen safe and sound.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: ...*gulp* Yeah.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Thank you, Trainer-san.
Thanks...
